purpose: Draws the Illustration line of a Value card: the value graph of its levels, read-only while an older stored list of levels is not moved, giving every change of the levels up whole through onChange.
namedChanges: Imports: `./PlanValueGraph` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-graph` (`PlanValueGraph`); `../../lib/base/planValue` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-card-model` (`carryOthers`, checked to be exported there); `ValueLineProps` is imported as a type from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-line-kit`. The symbol is otherwise unchanged.
Comments: none; the source's line comment ("The old stored list is read-only until it is moved into records.") has no name or tag. The file's header comment is the unit's own.
`tsconfig.json` leaves out `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, which the app's source is not compiled with.
